queue.description: Sales And Business Development Manager Post a Resume Sign in / Register Location Saved Enter 2 more character(s) to search... Sales And Business Development Manager Free Posted 53 minutes ago Business Development Clonee, Ireland Find Job > IE > Meath > Clonee > Other Jobs > Business Development > Sales And Business Development Manager Previous Next Sales And Business Development Manager Securitas Ireland Clonee, Meath, IE Published 2026-11-28 Description Job Description As a high-impact member of our sales team, you will accelerate organic growth by winning new customers and positioning our protective services as the solution to each client’s specific risks, priorities and business needs. You will accelerate organic growth by winning new customers and building a strong, locally generated pipeline across the Irish security services market. You will proactively build and convert a strong services pipeline—identifying opportunities, qualifying decision-makers, delivering compelling value-led proposals and confidently closing profitable, sustainable business. This is a hands-on new-business role for a proven commercial hunter who can open doors, access senior decision-makers and create opportunities from a standing start. You will use approved AI tools, CRM data and market intelligence responsibly to sharpen prospecting, personalise client engagement, identify next-best opportunities and improve the speed and quality of sales execution. Central to the role is the ability to articulate a clear client value proposition that connects our people, technology and intelligence capabilities to measurable outcomes such as stronger protection, greater resilience, operational efficiency and business continuity—demonstrating why clients should choose Securitas on value rather than price alone. With a relentless focus on the client, you will build trusted relationships from first contact through implementation, ensure a seamless customer experience and unlock further value through cross-selling and up-selling. The successful candidate will bring relevant security-services sales experience, established market knowledge and a demonstrable record of winning profitable new contracts. You will be expected to arrive ready to prospect, build relationships and generate commercial momentum from the outset. Your primary focus will be proactive business development: identifying prospects, creating demand, securing qualified meetings and converting opportunities into sustainable organic revenue. We are looking for an energetic, resilient and highly accountable salesperson who relishes the hunt, works with urgency and is motivated by measurable new-business results. This role will be central to rebuilding our local sales capability. Key Responsibilities: Client Acquisition and Market Development : Build and execute a disciplined new-business strategy aligned with Irish and European priorities. Identify high-potential sectors and accounts, map decision-makers and influencers, create tailored pursuit plans and maintain a consistent cadence of proactive outreach. Convert market insight into a healthy, qualified pipeline that delivers profitable organic growth across protective services. Demand and Lead Generation : Partner with marketing and operational teams to design targeted digital campaigns, sector-specific messaging and conversion journeys. Generate opportunities through phone, email, social selling, referrals, networking and reactivation of historic leads. Use approved AI tools, CRM data and market intelligence responsibly to prioritise prospects, personalise engagement and increase the volume and quality of qualified meetings. Hunter-Led New-Business Development : Take direct ownership of generating new business across the local market. Maintain a high and consistent level of prospecting activity, open doors into new accounts, secure access to relevant decision-makers and create opportunities where no established relationship currently exists. Local Pipeline and Organic Growth: Build a sustainable pipeline of locally originated opportunities that strengthens the organisation’s organic Convert pipeline activity into profitable, recurring security-services contracts. Market Presence and Relationship Development : Use existing industry knowledge, relationships and professional networks to create early commercial traction. Develop new relationships across target sectors and establish a visible presence within relevant Irish business, property, facilities management and security networks. Consultative Discovery and Qualification : Qualify opportunities against client need, decision process, urgency, commercial potential and strategic fit. Build rapport with stakeholders, ask probing questions and use remote demonstrations, video content, site information and structured risk assessments to uncover the client’s operational challenges, risk exposure and desired outcomes. Address objections credibly, agree clear next steps and disqualify weak opportunities early to protect selling capacity. Client Value Proposition and Solution Development : Translate client risks and business priorities into a clear, differentiated value proposition that connects Securitas people, technology, monitoring, data and intelligence capabilities to measurable outcomes. Develop tailored, easy-to-buy protective service solutions that demonstrate stronger protection, resilience, efficiency and business continuity, supported by a credible business case, transparent pricing, implementation approach and evidence of value. Compete on outcomes and total value rather than price alone. Commercial Pace and Accountability : Deliver measurable progress from the outset through disciplined activity, qualified opportunities and effective pipeline conversion. Operate with urgency, maintain accurate forecasts and take personal accountability for converting sales activity into revenue. Proposal, Negotiation and Closing : Own opportunities from proposal through contract signature. Produce compelling, accurate and commercially sound proposals with clear client outcomes, options, assumptions and next steps. Coordinate internal approvals, negotiate confidently, overcome final objections and close profitable, sustainable business within agreed pricing, margin, compliance and contractual guardrails. Maintain complete, current CRM records, including value, probability, stage, activity, decision date, risks and forecast. Implementation, Client Success and Growth : Lead a structured handover to operations and delivery teams, ensuring that scope, commitments, risks, commercials and success measures are fully understood. Remain actively involved through mobilisation and implementation, resolve issues quickly and confirm that the agreed value proposition is being delivered. Conduct post-implementation reviews, monitor satisfaction and outcomes, strengthen the relationship and identify cross-sell, up-sell, renewal and referral opportunities that increase retention, share of wallet and lifetime client value. Qualifications Essential Security-Services Sales Experience : Significant and recent experience selling manned guarding, protective services or closely related security services within the Irish market. Candidates whose experience is predominantly technical, product-based or outside the security-services sector must demonstrate directly transferable relationships and a proven ability to generate new service-contract revenue at pace. Proven B2 B Sales Performance: Demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets across the full B2 B sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, consultative discovery, value-led solution development, proposal management, negotiation and closing profitable, sustainable contracts. Immediate Market Readiness : Established understanding of the Irish security-services landscape, including relevant buyer groups, competitors, procurement routes, commercial models and operational considerations. The successful candidate must be capable of creating credible client conversations and commercial momentum from the outset. AI, Digital and CRM Capability: A proven track record of using approved AI-enabled sales tools, CRM platforms and digital channels responsibly to research prospects, prioritise leads, personalise outreach, improve follow-up, maintain strong pipeline hygiene and strengthen forecasting. Must apply sound commercial judgement and comply with data protection, security and internal governance requirements. Marketing and Lead-Generation Skills: Practical experience working with marketing colleagues to develop targeted campaigns, sector messaging, social selling, digital content and conversion activity. Able to turn market insight and client needs into compelling communications that generate qualified opportunities and support the client value proposition. Demonstrable achievement against new-business revenue, margin, pipeline and conversion targets. Candidates must be able to provide clear examples of contracts they personally originated, developed, negotiated and closed. Client Value and Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen, commercial awareness and negotiation capability, with the ability to articulate a clear value proposition, link protective services to measurable client outcomes and sell on value, quality, resilience and total cost of ownership rather than price alone. Relationship Building and Networking: Highly capable of creating and sustaining trusted relationships with prospects, clients, industry contacts and internal stakeholders. Must be confident building networks, accessing senior decision-makers, generating referrals and representing the organisation professionally across business forums, events and digital channels. A relevant network across sectors such as facilities management, commercial property, retail, logistics, manufacturing, technology, healthcare or other security-intensive environments will be a distinct advantage. One-Team Collaboration: A strong team player who works closely with the entire organisation, including sales, marketing, operations, technology, finance, legal and service-delivery colleagues. Must share information openly, clarify ownership, support joint client pursuits and remain engaged from opportunity creation through mobilisation and client success. Demonstrable Hunter Profile : A strong track record of personally originating and winning new business rather than relying primarily on inbound leads, inherited accounts, international referrals or established portfolios. Evidence should include proactive prospecting, opening new accounts, accessing senior decision-makers and converting self-generated opportunities into signed contracts. Highly motivated, self-starting and target-driven, with the resilience and personal accountability to create opportunities from a standing start, maintain momentum through complex sales cycles and deliver at pace in a fast-moving environment. Must demonstrate urgency, disciplined follow-through and a genuine hunger to win. Urgency, Energy and Return on Investment : A highly driven and self-sufficient approach, with the commercial appetite and personal accountability to deliver an early return on investment. The role requires someone who can operate independently, build pipeline immediately and begin producing measurable commercial outcomes. Additional Information At Securitas, we believe in rewarding our people for their hard work. We offer a range of great benefits designed to support our people and their families. These comprehensive benefits include discounted health care scheme, company pension, bike to work scheme, access to hundreds of discounts from well-known brands and retailers, access to hundreds of high-quality online education courses from some of the world’s leading learning institutions, ways to save for the future, and other resources to improve health and well-being. Benefits: Employer Contribution Pension Scheme from the day you join the Company Company phone and laptop Company Car with fuel/charge card, toll tag & parking Commission scheme On-Target Earnings (OTE) of up to 75% of base salary Progression, training and development opportunities Discounted Private Healthcare Scheme (Cash back on everyday medical costs, such as dental check-ups, optical, GP and Emergency Department visits.) Private health insurance Free onsite parking Substantial Maternity Leave top up payment 24 hour EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) free confidential counselling and advice supporting our employees in a number of areas. Christmas Savings Scheme Bicycle to work scheme from the day you join the Company (Save up to 52% on a bike and accessories) 25 days annual leave Securitas is an equal opportunities Employer P. S. A. queue.title: Sales Engineer Oil Free Division
queue.description: Your role As a Sales Engineer within the Atlas Copco Oil Free Air (OFA) Division, your mission is to help industrial customers improve productivity, reduce operating costs, and achieve their sustainability goals through innovative utility and energy-efficient solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor, identifying opportunities across customers' entire utility infrastructure and delivering integrated solutions that drive operational excellence, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation. Your day-to-day Grow Atlas Copco's Oil Free Air and Total Utility Solutions business across your assigned territory through a combination of new business development and account management. Build strong relationships with customers across manufacturing, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, medical device, data centre, public sector and general industry sectors. Identify opportunities to improve customer productivity, reliability, energy efficiency and sustainability through compressed air and gas systems, heat recovery, heat pumps, steam compressors, chillers, cooling systems and other utility solutions. Conduct site surveys, energy assessments and system reviews to understand customer operations, challenges and future objectives. Develop a deep understanding of the customer's complete utility ecosystem and identify opportunities to optimise energy use across the entire facility. Inspire customers to think beyond individual equipment purchases and adopt a long-term utility strategy that delivers measurable improvements in operating costs, carbon reduction and operational performance. Promote and champion Atlas Copco's Total Utility Solutions approach by demonstrating how integrated technologies can maximise efficiency and accelerate decarbonisation objectives. Prepare and present compelling technical and commercial proposals that clearly communicate both financial and environmental value. Manage opportunities from initial engagement through solution development, project execution and successful handover, working closely with the Projects team and other internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Projects and Service colleagues to deliver a seamless and exceptional customer experience. Maintain an active and healthy sales pipeline through effective territory planning, prospecting and opportunity management. Act as a trusted advisor to customers by sharing industry best practice, energy-saving opportunities and Atlas Copco innovations. Your skills and experience We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role. An engineering qualification, technical apprenticeship, or equivalent industry experience. Previous experience in a sales, application engineering, business development or customer-facing technical role. Experience within compressed air, industrial equipment, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, automation, HVAC, process cooling, heat pumps, energy management, utilities or a related industry would be advantageous. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify opportunities, create value propositions and develop long-term customer relationships. An understanding of industrial energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives, carbon reduction strategies or utility optimisation would be advantageous. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities within a dynamic sales environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word, together with CRM systems. Full clean driving licence. Eligible to work in Ireland Your compensation and benefits The opportunity to join the global leader in compressed air and industrial productivity solutions. A newly created position within a growing business, providing the opportunity to make a real impact on the future success of the Oil Free Air division. A collaborative and supportive team environment with access to experienced colleagues across Sales, Projects and Service. Industry-leading products and technologies, including the most energy-efficient compressed air solutions, and innovative total utilities solutions in the market. Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, with continuous investment in your professional development. The freedom and autonomy to manage your territory and build long-term customer relationships. The backing of a global organisation with over 150 years of innovation and a strong commitment to employee development. A competitive salary and bonus package, company vehicle, laptop and smartphone. An attractive benefits package including pension, health insurance, life assurance and 25 days annual leave. Long-term career development opportunities within Atlas Copco Group. Salary Salary: €51,000 - €62,000 gross per annum, depending on skills, experience, and qualifications. Why this role is different This role is not focused on selling a single product line. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted partner to industrial customers, helping them reimagine how utilities are generated, recovered and consumed across their facilities. Success will come from identifying opportunities others miss, connecting technologies across multiple applications, and delivering meaningful reductions in both energy costs and CO₂ emissions while supporting our customers on their journey towards a more sustainable future. Application process Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us: Talent Acquisition: Rob Buckingham

queue.title: Sales and Business Development Representative, Local-MSBR
queue.description: Short Description As a Sales and Business Development Representative, your mission will be to position Hall Pyke as the partner of choice for process filtration solutions, validation services, laboratory testing, and on-site integrity testing across Ireland. Working across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, medical device, food & beverage, and industrial manufacturing sectors, you will be responsible for supporting sustainable growth through the development of new business opportunities and the expansion of existing customer relationships. Reporting to the Hall Pyke Integration Manager and Process Filtration Business Line Manager (Ireland & UK), you will play a key role in growing Hall Pyke's Process Filtration business, helping to ensure we are first in mind and first in choice when customers require specialist filtration expertise and support. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, Hall Pyke combines the flexibility and technical expertise of a trusted Irish specialist with the resources, innovation, and global reach of a world-leading industrial organisation. Your skills and experience Hall Pyke has an exciting opportunity for an ambitious and enthusiastic sales professional who is self-motivated, eager to learn, and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are excited to see what you can bring to the role. Be eligible to work in Ireland. Possess a degree in Engineering, Science, Business, or equivalent qualifications and experience. Have experience in sales, business development, customer service, technical support, or account management. Have strong communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills. Demonstrate a customer-focused and consultative approach. Have an understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food & beverage, life sciences, or industrial manufacturing environments. Knowledge of process filtration, validation services, or GMP-regulated industries would be advantageous. Be computer literate in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Your compensation and benefits The opportunity to join one of Ireland's leading filtration specialists and an Atlas Copco Group company. A friendly, motivated, and supportive team ready to welcome you. A competitive salary and performance-related bonus scheme. Company vehicle, laptop, and mobile phone. Ongoing technical and professional development, with access to Atlas Copco Group training programmes. A competitive benefits package, including pension contributions. Excellent career development opportunities within Hall Pyke and the wider Atlas Copco Group. A rewarding career helping customers improve product quality, process efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Your job location This role is fully remote and employed through our legal entity in Dublin, Ireland. Other locations may be possible to review. Why it is great to work with us Hall Pyke is a leading provider of specialist filtration and separation solutions, supporting customers across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, food & beverage, and industrial manufacturing sectors. Through our expertise in process filtration, laboratory testing, validation support, and on-site integrity testing, we help customers improve product quality, optimise manufacturing processes, and meet demanding regulatory standards. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, we are continuing to invest in our Process Filtration business and expand into new high-growth markets. This role offers a unique opportunity to build a successful career in technical sales while working with industry-leading technologies, services, and customers. Application process Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us: Talent Acquisition: Helena Carmichael

You will inspire and develop your leadership team, create a high-performing environment, and drive strong business and customer results. Your day-to-day What You'll Do Lead, coach, and develop Service Team Leaders , building strong leadership capability. Create a culture of ownership, accountability, engagement, and high performance . Drive business results across customer satisfaction, profitability, and operational excellence . Lead change and continuous improvement , empowering teams to challenge the status quo and find better ways of working. Build strong partnerships across the business to achieve shared goals. Create a safe, inclusive, and engaging workplace where people can perform at their best. Your skills and experience Who You Are You are an inspiring and experienced people leader who delivers results through others. You set clear direction, develop strong leaders, and create an environment where people take ownership and succeed. Sales And Business Development Executive 75,000 € Posted 20 hours ago Business Development Workfromhome, Ireland Find Job > IE > Other Jobs > Business Development > Sales And Business Development Executive Previous Next Sales And Business Development Executive StudioForty9 Workfromhome, County Cork, IE 45,000 - 75,000 € Published 2026-11-27 Description Job Description Studio Forty9 is hiring a Sales and Business Development Executive. You'll prospect for new business, drive every net new deal through our pipeline, and own the monthly sales KPIs that our leadership team runs the business on. You'll report to our Head of Growth & Marketing. You won't do every step of a sale yourself, but you'll make sure every step gets done. Our Senior Leadership Team (SLT) usually leads scoping, pricing and most presentations and pitches. Your job is to find the opportunities, keep each deal moving, and make sure nothing stalls between first contact and signing. As you build experience, you'll take on more of the pitching and closing yourself. You'll also be our main point of contact for Shopify, and make sure every sale of a partner tool is recorded so we receive the commission we're owed. You'll need to know ecommerce and Shopify well, be comfortable working to targets, and be the kind of person who keeps a CRM accurate because you want the numbers to be right. The role is fully remote, but you'll be out at events and meeting clients in person a few times a month. Most of that is in Ireland, with the odd trip abroad. AI and LLM tools are a big part of how we sell, so using them every day is a must. Key Responsibilities Net New Sales Work towards the net new revenue target, and contribute to the company revenue target across new and existing business. Prospect for new business, and build pipeline from referrals, Shopify, events, campaigns and inbound leads. Get back to new enquiries quickly, qualify them, and follow up every lead. Run intro and discovery calls, and to scope the work for initial indicative pricing. Coordinate scoping and pricing with our Senior Leadership Team (SLT), and keep it moving so proposals go out on time. Prepare proposals, and support the SLT on presentations and pitches until you're ready to lead them yourself. Follow up open proposals until there's a decision. Make sure signed projects are handed over to delivery with a clear, agreed scope. Existing Clients Support Account Managers and the wider team to get proposals for existing clients out on time. Make sure every existing-client opportunity is logged in the CRM, so the pipeline shows the full picture. Pipeline Admin & Sales KPIs Own the monthly sales KPIs, with the goal of closing every month at or above forecast. Follow up with internal teams throughout the month to get sales across the line, and flag early when the month is at risk of falling short. Keep the CRM accurate, realistic and up to date: stages, values, close dates and next steps on every deal. Keep the forecast current, and flag deals that are slipping early. Send weekly and monthly sales updates to the leadership team, and prepare the sales figures for the quarterly board report. Make sure signed work is set up correctly for delivery and invoicing, working with our finance team. Agree sales targets with the Head of Growth & Marketing, and take part in sales, marketing and product/services planning. Shopify & Partner Revenue Be Studio Forty9's main point of contact for Shopify, and own that partner relationship. Work with Shopify on referrals, joint opportunities and our standing in their partner programme. Make sure every sale of a partner tool or app is recorded, and that we receive the commission or referral fee that goes with it. Track partner commissions with our finance team, and chase anything that's missing. Events & Marketing Work with brand marketing on events, campaigns and sales materials that bring in qualified leads. Represent Studio Forty9 in person at our own events and industry events throughout the year. Follow up the leads that come from events and campaigns. Other partner relationships, such as co-marketing with technology partners, sit outside this role. How Success Is Measured Net new revenue Value of signed net new work against target Monthly sales KPIs Each month closed at or above forecast, with early warning given when it's at risk Pipeline Qualified pipeline for the next quarter against target Forecast accuracy How close the sales and invoices forecasts are to what we invoice and the sales that are confirmed Lead response How quickly new enquiries are contacted and qualified Partner revenue Shopify referrals won, and all partner tool commissions recorded and received Handover Projects reaching delivery with a clear, agreed scope Skills & Experience3+ years in B2 B sales or business development, ideally selling ecommerce, agency or Saa S services. A track record of building pipeline and contributing to new business targets. Good knowledge of ecommerce, and working knowledge of Shopify (required). Experience prospecting and moving deals through a sales process, from first contact to signed proposal. Confident on calls and in meetings with senior people, and keen to lead pitches yourself over time. Good with numbers, from keeping a forecast to reporting KPIs. Strong CRM habits, ideally in Hub Spot. You keep the pipeline accurate without being chased. You use AI and LLM tools in your work every day (essential). Happy to travel a few times a month, mostly within Ireland. Happy to plan your own week and own your numbers, and you'll flag it early when a deal is slipping. Very organised, with a great eye for detail. A clear, honest communicator, in writing and on calls. You'd rather listen and advise than push a sale. Nice to Have Contacts in Irish retail and ecommerce. Experience working with the Shopify Partner Program, or another tech partner programme. Knowledge of EPOS and ERP integrations or platform migrations. Experience selling through events. Who are Studio Forty9 Studio Forty9 is a recognised leader in the Irish digital sector, with an award-winning and proven track record of delivering, maintaining and continuously improving high-performance ecommerce and omnichannel retail solutions for the Irish retail industry. The Studio Forty9 team is experienced, innovative and committed to excellence, and we count some of Ireland's most experienced ecommerce professionals among our number. Our experience and ability have led us to work with some of Ireland's household names in retail. We have helped those companies grow by capturing extra market share, serving their in-store and online customers across a wider range of channels, and opening up overseas markets with the integrations, automated processes and workflows needed to scale an online business for international sales. We operate on a partnership approach where our clients come first, and we strive to develop long‑term and meaningful relationships. Benefits Studio Forty9 are proud to be early adopters of the most progressive and human‑centred approaches to work life. Business Development Representative, Benelux 90,000 € Posted 21 hours ago Business Development Dublin, Ireland Find Job > IE > Dublin > Dublin > Other Jobs > Business Development > Business Development Representative, Benelux Previous Next Business Development Representative, Benelux Notion Enterprise Dublin, Dublin, IE 70,000 - 90,000 € Published 2026-11-27 Description Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn't to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business's system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life's work. About the Role: Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model - and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work - and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days. What You'll Achieve: Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy Run multi-channel outbound campaigns - email, phone, Linked In, and events to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk" - validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion Skills You'll Need to Bring: Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response Sharp qualification instincts - able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. Fluency in Dutch Nice to Haves: Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. With a reputation for innovation, reliability, and market-leading hardware and software, our client helps organizations streamline document workflows, cut print costs, and modernize their workplace infrastructure. Role Overview Our client is seeking a driven, commercially astute Print Sales Executive to join their growing sales team. Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving new business acquisition and developing existing accounts across your designated territory. You will take a consultative approach to selling our client’s portfolio of multifunction printers (MFPs), Managed Print Services, and document management solutions. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Proactively prospect, cold call, network, and book client meetings to build a strong, consistent sales pipeline across SME and corporate accounts. Consultative Selling & Print Audits: Meet with key decision-makers (IT Managers, Operations Directors, Finance, and Procurement) to assess existing print environments, conduct print audits, and identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities. Proposal & Solution Design: Partner with pre-sales and technical specialists to tailor commercial proposals, calculate ROI/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), and present winning Managed Print Service contracts. Account Management: Nurture and expand an existing portfolio of client accounts, maximizing retention, contract renewals, and cross-selling of software and digital workplace solutions. Pipeline & CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of all sales activity, leads, and revenue forecasts using the company CRM, meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly KPIs. Candidate Requirements Sales Experience: Minimum of 2–3+ years’ proven B2 B field sales or business development experience, ideally within Managed Print Services (MPS), office technology, telecoms, Saa S, or commercial print. Commercial Acumen: Demonstrable track record of consistently hitting or exceeding revenue targets, negotiating lease/service agreements, and closing B2 B contracts. Consultative Approach: Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with C-level, IT, and procurement stakeholders. Self-Motivation: Highly organized, target-driven, and comfortable managing your own diary and territory independently. Mobility: Full, clean Irish/EU driving licence. Direct industry experience selling leading print brands (e.g., Ricoh, Canon, Konica Minolta, Xerox, Sharp, or Kyocera). Familiarity with print management software (e.g., Paper Cut, Equitrac, Safe Q) and lease financing structures. What’s on Offer Competitive base salary + uncapped commission scheme with strong OTE potential. Company car or generous car allowance + fuel card. Comprehensive benefits package including pension and healthcare. Laptop, mobile phone, and full home/field working setup. World-class product training and long-term career progression within a global brand. Candidates must be eligible to work full time and long term in the location specified or currently hold a valid appropriate long term work Visa to apply. IE 61,600 - 78,400 € Published 2026-11-26 Description As a member of our Renewals team, you will be instrumental in defining, testing, and growing a renewals model that balances high volume scale with top-down positioning. The Renewals team is an integral part of Asana's success, partnering with customers and internal stakeholders such as Account Executives, Customer Success Managers & Finance to ensure Asana customers are set up for continued success from their Asana investment. Your primary focus will be managing client renewals to maximize retention, identify expansion opportunities, and drive a high degree of customer satisfaction. This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. What you’ll achieve Secure and Retain Revenue: Protect revenue, incentivize multi-year agreements, and secure renewal contracts in advance of expiration. Close Renewals: Understand customer needs and demonstrate account management capabilities to bring renewals to closure. Engage Key Stakeholders: Partner with decision-makers to identify customer requirements, budget, core stakeholders, and approval processes while uncovering roadblocks to ensure on-time commitments. Manage Territory Processes: Own and execute the quote-to-close processes for all renewals within an assigned territory. Defend Market Share: Effectively defend against competitive pressures. Forecast Accurately: Maintain and report an accurate rolling 90-day forecast of renewals. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate and effectively partner with Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Legal, Finance, and Sales Management to navigate complex customer requests. Drive Process Efficiency: Assist with enhancing and improving systems and processes to increase internal operational efficiencies. About you 2-5 years of experience with software/subscription renewals or account management; Saa S experience is a plus. Fluency in German. Proficiency in contract negotiations, value selling, discovery, closing skills, and a consistent track record of quota achievement. Strong organizational and time-management skills, paired with precise written and verbal communication attributes. Experience creating pricing presentations and delivering them to C-level customers. Thrives when partnering with Sales and Customer Success teams to achieve common organizational goals. Ability to drive momentum and on-time renewals by connecting dots at large organizations, influencing stakeholders, and driving collaboration. Approaches work with empathy and a creative, problem-solving mindset. Capable of balancing a complex book of business while maintaining customer satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. What we’ll offer Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit. For this role, the estimated base salary range is between €61,600 - €78,400. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. Git Lab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust Git Lab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Git Lab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. An overview of this role Reports to: Manager, Renewals This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager. What You'll Do Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure. Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next. Identify and surface expansion opportunities - additional seats, tiers, or modules - that come out of those conversations. Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant Git Lab capabilities they aren't yet using. Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified. Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule. Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified. Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving. Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to Git Lab's communication framework. Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting. Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results. Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM's. What You'll Bring Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms. Developing understanding of Git Lab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture. Awareness of Git Lab's remote work best practices. Growth mindset and sense of ownership - proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately. Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager. The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc. About the team The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing Git Lab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand Git Lab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best. Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations About Kirby Group Engineering Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance. HV Secondary Design Engineer Join Kirby Group Engineering and play a key role in delivering critical high-voltage infrastructure projects that power industries, communities, and economies. We’re looking for an experienced HV Secondary Design Engineer to join our growing Power & Renewables team. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most significant grid and energy projects across Ireland and Europe, helping to design the protection, control and automation systems that sit at the heart of modern electrical networks. What You’ll Be Doing As an HV Secondary Design Engineer, you’ll be responsible for the design, development and review of HV substation secondary systems, ensuring the highest standards of safety, reliability and technical excellence. Your responsibilities will include: Preparing HV substation secondary wiring designs and detailed technical documentation. Producing panel layouts, LV and DC distribution designs, control schematics and protection drawings for HV substations. Designing protection and control systems that ensure the safe and reliable operation of substation equipment. Developing protection philosophies, schemes and logic to safeguard critical network assets. Supporting the integration of protection and control systems with SCADA and substation automation systems. Designing robust and resilient solutions with appropriate levels of redundancy and reliability. Ensuring designs comply with IEC, IEEE, ANSI, Eir Grid, SONI and other relevant industry standards. Supporting the safe design and operation of systems under normal, abnormal and fault conditions. Reviewing consultant and third-party secondary designs to ensure technical compliance and project requirements are met. Collaborating with project engineers to manage design review schedules, comments and client submissions. Engaging directly with consultants and stakeholders to resolve technical queries and drive successful outcomes. Supporting factory acceptance testing, site testing, commissioning and troubleshooting activities. Working closely with electrical, civil, commissioning and project delivery teams throughout the project lifecycle. Providing technical support to clients and ensuring solutions meet operational requirements. Assisting with fault investigations, protection system issues and maintenance activities. Contributing to system upgrades, network modifications and the implementation of new technologies. Supporting the development and training of engineers, technicians and wider project teams. What We’re Looking For You’ll bring a strong technical background in HV protection and control engineering, along with a proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving. Ideally, you’ll have: Experience in HV substation secondary design, protection and control engineering. A strong understanding of electrical protection systems, control philosophies and power system fundamentals. Experience producing detailed secondary design documentation and protection schematics. Knowledge of SCADA integration and substation automation systems. Familiarity with relevant industry standards including IEC, IEEE, ANSI, Eir Grid and SONI requirements. Experience reviewing and validating third-party consultant designs. Knowledge of testing, commissioning and system integration activities. Proficiency in design software such as EPLAN, Auto CAD and related engineering tools. Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Why Join Kirby Group Engineering? At Kirby Group Engineering, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a genuine one-team culture where collaboration, mentorship and continuous development are part of everyday life. You’ll work alongside some of the industry’s most talented engineers on complex and technically challenging projects that are helping to shape the future of energy infrastructure. In return, you’ll benefit from: The opportunity to work on major HV transmission and renewable energy projects. Career progression within a market-leading engineering organisation. Ongoing professional development and technical training. Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and industry-leading projects. A supportive, collaborative and people-first culture. Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important market, working closely with Ireland's main government water organisation and key industry stakeholders to promote Siemens' leading automation, digitalisation and electrification solutions. The Water & Wastewater sector is one of Siemens Digital Industries' largest and fastest-growing market segments in Ireland, supported by significant long-term infrastructure investment and an established customer base. This role offers the opportunity to shape future growth across a strategically important sector while helping deliver critical infrastructure for communities across Ireland. The Role As the dedicated Account Manager for the Water & Wastewater sector, you will take ownership of developing and executing a growth strategy across Ireland, identifying opportunities, building relationships and driving long-term business growth. Working closely with end users, consultants, system integrators, OEMs, engineering contractors and Siemens partners, you will influence project specifications, develop opportunities and position Siemens as a preferred technology partner. Success in this role will come from building trusted customer relationships, identifying new opportunities, influencing project specifications and driving sustainable business growth across the sector. Key Responsibilities Develop and grow strategic relationships with key water and wastewater customers, particularly Ireland's main government water organisation. Drive sustainable business growth by identifying opportunities where Siemens solutions can add value and increase market presence within the sector. Develop and execute a growth strategy for the Water & Wastewater market across Ireland. Promote Siemens' automation, digitalisation, electrification and related technology solutions. Engage with consultants, system integrators, OEMs, engineering contractors and partners to influence specifications and identify opportunities. Develop and strengthen relationships across the wider water and wastewater ecosystem. Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across water treatment, wastewater treatment and associated infrastructure projects. Work collaboratively with Siemens' technical and commercial teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. About You Proven sales, account management or business development experience. Experience selling technical solutions within industrial automation, electrical engineering, process industries, infrastructure or related technical environments. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Ability to engage with customers, consultants and technical decision-makers. Proven ability to identify, develop and convert new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships. A proactive and commercially focused approach, with a passion for building long-term customer partnerships and delivering growth. Experience within the water and wastewater sector would be advantageous. We also welcome applications from candidates with experience in industrial automation, process industries, electrical infrastructure, utilities, manufacturing or other technical solution-based sales environments. Experience working with consultants, system integrators, OEMs, contractors or channel partners would also be beneficial. We know that strong candidates may not meet every requirement listed above. If your experience comes from an adjacent industry and you have a track record of building customer relationships and successfully selling technical or engineering-led solutions, we encourage you to apply. Why Siemens? Join a global technology leader at the forefront of industrial automation, digitalisation and electrification. You'll take ownership of one of Siemens Digital Industries' most important growth markets in Ireland, working on critical infrastructure projects and helping customers modernise water and wastewater operations through innovative technology solutions. This is an opportunity to build strategic industry relationships, influence major infrastructure programmes and play a key role in supporting the future of Ireland's water and wastewater infrastructure while developing your own career within a global technology organisation. What can we offer? Performance-Based Bonus: Enjoy an annual bonus linked to the company's performance Flexible Working Hours: Achieve a healthy work-life balance with our flexible working arrangements Pension Plan: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme, with employer contributions up to 10%. Time Off: Recharge and rejuvenate with 26 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), and the option to buy or sell an additional 5 days! Join a Growing Sector: Be part of one of Siemens Digital Industries' largest and fastest-growing market segments in Ireland, supported by significant long-term investment in critical infrastructure. We are fully committed to providing equal opportunities and building an inclusive workplace where a broad range of backgrounds and perspectives thrive. We embrace the many ways people think, learn, and experience the world—because we know that diverse minds drive innovation. Contract: Full-Time, Permanent. The Lough Credit Union is a progressive financial services provider with over 14,000 members and total assets of over €115 ml. Our core values are to promote the financial well-being of our members and develop our community economically. We are committed to providing a broad range of innovative financial products and services. About the Opportunity We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Senior Loans Manager to head our Lending Team and play a key role in our continued growth and development. This is an exciting opportunity for a lending professional who wants to move beyond traditional personal lending and play a broader role across personal loans, mortgages, SME and community lending. The Role Act as a key point of contact for members across the full lending journey. Assess and process personal, mortgage, SME and community lending applications in accordance with the Credit Union's lending policies and delegated authority. Provide professional guidance to members, identifying appropriate lending solutions based on their individual circumstances and financial needs. Manage applications from initial enquiry through underwriting, approval, documentation and final drawdown. Conduct detailed affordability assessments, credit checks and risk assessments. Prepare clear and robust credit recommendations for consideration where applications fall outside delegated lending authority. Ensure lending decisions are commercially sound, responsible, consistent and aligned with the Credit Union's risk appetite and credit policy which you will have responsibility for. Support members in understanding the range of lending products available, including personal loans, home improvement loans, vehicle finance, mortgages and SME. Work closely with colleagues across the Credit Union to deliver a seamless member experience. Maintain accurate and comprehensive lending records and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant. Ensure all lending activity complies with relevant legislation, regulatory requirements, Credit Union policies, AML requirements and internal controls. Contribute to lending goals, service standards and strategic objectives. Support colleagues by sharing lending expertise, knowledge and best practice. What We're Looking For We are seeking an individual who combines strong lending expertise with excellent interpersonal and commercial skills. Ideally, you will have: 5+ years' experience in lending within a Credit Union, bank or other financial services environment desired. Strong personal lending and credit assessment experience. Experience in mortgage lending is essential and SME lending is desirable. Strong underwriting and financial analysis capability. Good understanding of credit risk and responsible lending principles. Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills. Strong IT & strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities. A proactive, member-focused and solutions-oriented approach. The ability to work independently while managing staff in a wider team. Qualifications The successful candidate will ideally hold: A third-level qualification in finance, business or a related discipline would be an advantage, but not essential. We will also consider candidates with strong practical lending experience who are committed to continuing their professional development. The successful candidates will be required to satisfy the Minimum Competency Code requirements as set out by the Central Bank. We specialise in the mid‑market, supporting individuals, family businesses, and organisations with a full suite of services including audit, tax, corporate finance, payroll, people consultancy, and wealth management. With 1,000+ team members, we deliver expert support to clients all over the world. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We succeed together as one team, building strong client relationships through passion, empathy, and straightforward advice. That’s what makes AAB different. We invest in brilliant talent across every area of the business, offering tailored training, professional qualifications, and continuous support to help you grow. Your growth matters to us. We’ll give you the tools, encouragement, and opportunities to lead, learn, and make an impact. Guided by our six core values, we foster a culture where collaboration, trust, and enthusiasm thrive. AABSOLUTELY DEDICATED TO HELPING YOU ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS At AAB, your career is what you make it. We are here to help you turn ambition into action, whether that’s becoming a technical expert, a future leader, or someone who simply makes a difference every day. In this role, you’ll be responsible for supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the office environment, ensuring reception operations, facilities and services are delivered to a high standard. This role combines front-of-house reception duties, with facilities coordination, providing a professional and welcoming experience for staff, visitors, and clients. You will also assist with document processing for the wider group in line with our OSS Freshdesk that supports Group stakeholders with preparation of key documents various administrative tasks. At AAB, you’ll enjoy a balance of local responsibilities and cross-location collaboration. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your internal network, develop your administrative and communication skills, and contribute to a supportive and dynamic workplace. Maintain a full understanding of meeting room hospitality arrangements, coordinating catering requests with service providers in a timely and accurate manner. Oversee the day-to-day operations of meeting rooms , including calendar management, preventing scheduling conflicts, and accommodating last-minute changes when necessary. Manage incoming mail by scanning, saving to In Tapp , and sending document links to relevant team members. Process outgoing mail , including franking and preparing documentation for recorded or couriered deliveries. Respond promptly and efficiently to Money Penny enquiries. Liaise with contractors, cleaners, and maintenance providers to resolve equipment or facility issues quickly and effectively. Order and maintain office supplies , including stationery, couriers, taxis, and confidential waste collections. Serve as the first point of contact for team members on all office-related queries, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations. Maintain a record of cheques, take Visa Payments and manage the office credit card. Support health and safety compliance, including fire safety checks, evacuation equipment and accident reporting. Assist with office moves, desk setups and workspace changes. Administrative and Document Support (OSS Freshdesk) Produce high-quality documents — including letters, reports, proposals — using all Microsoft Office applications. Prepare and coordinate mail merges for local Business Units, ensuring accuracy and delivery to the appropriate destinations by required deadlines. Review all document content to ensure it is accurate, error-free, and compliant with brand guidelines and quality standards Manage electronic signing processes of client documentation through Docu Sign . Support with the preparation of expense and mileage claims in a timely and accurate manner. Collaborate with the Operational Support Team on ad hoc projects, process improvements, and new initiatives to enhance efficiency and service delivery. Provide general administrative and data entry support to the Office or Business Unit as required. Full training will be provided Experience & qualifications Key Skills and Attributes Excellent organisational and strong communication skills Excellent use of Microsoft Word, Powerpoint and Excel essential. Knowledge of Outlook and Teams is advantageous. Ability to multi-task, work under pressure and adhere to strict time pressures Attention to detail Ability to engage with a range of stakeholders Role Requirements Experience in office administration, facilities or reception role An understanding of a professional services organisation is advantageous but not essential A proactive and positive attitude to problem solving and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team Work Environment A collaborative office setting, with a focus on high standards of stakeholder/client service and compliance As a successful and evolving company, we’re always open to ideas and suggestions to enhance efficiencies As part of AAB you will be part of an energetic and stimulating environment alongside supportive and engaging professional teammates. queue.title: Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst
queue.description: Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst Post a Resume Sign in / Register Location Saved Enter 2 more character(s) to search... Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst 65,000 € Posted 5 days ago Supply Chain Ireland Find Job > IE > Logistics > Supply Chain > Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst Previous Next Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst Primark IE 45,000 - 65,000 € Published 2026-11-22 Description Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. Supply Chain at Primark Our supply chain team is the backbone of our operational efficiency. Dive into the intricacies of supply chain management, contributing to the seamless flow of our products from production to delivery around the globe. Collaborate with a team dedicated to optimising our supply chain processes and bring your logistical expertise to our organisation. What You’ll Do The Inbound Supply Chain Senior Analyst plays a critical role within the Commercial and Contracts Inbound team, supporting the Commercial & Contracts Manager through the delivery of accurate reporting, insightful analysis, financial reconciliations, auditing, rate card management, and oversight of DDS (Detention, Demurrage and Storage) and rebate processes. This role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, maintaining robust financial controls, delivering meaningful business intelligence, and driving continuous improvement across inbound supply chain operations. Through proactive stakeholder engagement and analytical expertise, the Inbound Supply Chain Analyst will support informed decision‑making, identify risks and opportunities, and contribute to the effective management of inbound supply chain costs and performance. We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities: Manage and govern inbound freight rate cards across all transport modes, ensuring data accuracy, robust controls and timely resolution of rate‑related queries and discrepancies. Review and reconcile supplier statements, invoices and supporting documentation, ensuring compliance with agreed commercial terms and financial controls. Partner with Inbound, Supply Chain and Finance teams to investigate, resolve and prevent data, invoice and reconciliation issues. Coordinate quarterly freight manager audits and maintain accurate audit, rebate and commercial datasets to support period‑end reporting and governance requirements. Manage DDS (Detention, Demurrage and Storage) reporting, reconciliation and charge validation processes, working with stakeholders to identify root causes and reduce associated costs. Oversee rebate validation, control and reporting processes, ensuring claims are accurately reviewed, tracked and finalised within agreed timelines. Deliver high‑quality reporting, dashboards and business intelligence that provide visibility of performance, costs, risks and opportunities, supporting commercial and operational decision‑making. Support budget management activities through the monitoring of spend, supplier performance, cost variances, savings initiatives and benefits realisation across the inbound supply chain. Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, proactively driving process improvements, resolving operational and commercial challenges and supporting broader reporting and analytics initiatives. What You’ll Get People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, a potential bonus, 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. What You’ll Bring At Primark, we focus on assisting you in developing your mindset and skillset to you reach your potential. Here’s a more detailed breakdown of the experience you’ll need: Strong analytical, problem‑solving and numerical skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Experience working with large and complex datasets, reconciliations and financial or commercial reporting. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, pivot tables, lookups and reporting techniques. Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience interpreting data and generating insights to support business decision‑making. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across multiple functions. Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment, with a track record of identifying process improvements and implementing sustainable solutions. About Primark Primark is an international clothing retailer employing more than 70,000 colleagues across 16 countries in Europe and the US. Founded in Ireland in 1969 under the Penneys brand, Primark aims to create maximum joy at minimum cost – less money and less impact on the planet. Primark continues to expand across new and existing markets with the aim of reaching 530 stores by the end of 2026. Every person impacts the culture at Primark. Our values: Caring (we always strive to put people first), Dynamic (we bravely push the boundaries to stay ahead) and Together (we learn more, laugh more and achieve more as we work with each other, our customers, our suppliers and our partners). Let’s see what impact you can make! #J-18808-Ljbffr Location Ireland Advertisement: Attributes Job type Full time Contract type Permanent Salary type Per annum Min. queue.description: Functieomschrijving Job description En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente. Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle. Avantages : Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise Rabais d’entreprise Assurance vie Les responsabilités sont les suivantes: Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits. Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles. Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin. Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail. Submit Business Development Engineer Business Development Engineer 30 Oct 2026 Ireland Permanent / Full Time About the Company Our client is a growing Irish business that surveys the ocean and delivers the data behind offshore renewable energy projects. They work with developers around the world, supplying the information needed to plan and build offshore wind farms and other marine infrastructure. It’s a small, close-knit team of engineers, scientists and offshore specialists, with a strong appetite to grow internationally. About the Opportunity This is a role for someone who likes the mix of technical and commercial. You’ll be the link between clients and the engineering team: finding new opportunities, understanding what developers need to measure offshore, and turning that into winning proposals. You’ll have plenty of ownership and direct contact with the people designing and delivering the work. Business development experience is welcome but not essential. We’re looking for technical curiosity, commercial instinct and a drive to win business. queue.description: Job Title: Assistant Procurement Manager Location: Cork Contract Type: Full-Time | Permanent Salary: €60,000 - €70,000 per year Days and Hours of Work: Monday - Friiday 8:30 Am - 5:00 PM (Flexibility requiered) Reporting to: Procurement Manager About the Opportunity Our client is a leading Irish wholesale and distribution business with a long-established reputation for supplying a diverse range of products to customers across multiple sectors. Due to continued growth and investment in its procurement function, they are seeking an ambitious and commercially focused Assistant Procurement Manager to join their team. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced procurement professional looking to develop their career within a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Working closely with senior leadership, the successful candidate will contribute to sourcing, supplier management, inventory optimisation, pricing strategy, and overall procurement performance. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, commercially minded, analytical, and eager to progress into a more strategic procurement role in the future. The Role The Assistant Procurement Manager will support the development and execution of procurement strategies that align with business objectives while helping to drive profitability, service levels, product availability, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Procurement Strategy Support the Procurement Manager in developing and implementing procurement strategies aligned with business objectives. Assist in identifying opportunities to improve procurement processes and commercial performance. Market Analysis & Commercial Insight Monitor market trends, supplier activity, pricing movements, and industry developments. Analyse market intelligence to support informed purchasing decisions. Identify potential risks and opportunities within supply markets. Product & Range Management Support the management and development of product portfolios. Help maintain competitive and commercially attractive product ranges. Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for improvement or expansion. Supply Chain & Procurement Operations Assist in managing procurement activities including demand planning, forecasting, purchase orders, stock transfers, and inventory replenishment. Work closely with suppliers to ensure product availability and service requirements are achieved. Monitor supplier lead times, capacity constraints, and delivery schedules. Inventory Management Support inventory planning and stock management activities. Assist in implementing inventory optimisation initiatives. Cost & Supplier Management Support supplier negotiations relating to pricing, terms, service levels, and commercial agreements. Assist with tender processes, RFQs, RFPs, and supplier evaluations. Build and maintain strong supplier relationships focused on value, quality, availability, and innovation. Drive supplier performance improvements through effective collaboration. Pricing & Margin Management Analyse pricing trends, competitor activity, and market conditions. Support pricing strategies that improve profitability while maintaining competitiveness. Collaborate with sales teams to ensure commercial objectives are achieved. Performance Analysis & Reporting Track key procurement and category performance metrics including sales, margins, inventory levels, service levels, and supplier performance. Produce analytical reports and recommendations to support business decisions. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with sales, operations, logistics, finance, and supplier partners. Build effective relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups. Procurement Administration & Systems Ensure procurement administration activities are completed accurately and efficiently. Manage purchase requisitions, purchase orders, stock transfers, supplier invoices, credit notes, and related documentation. Support the effective use of ERP and purchasing systems to streamline procurement processes. Essential Requirements Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Commerce, or a related discipline. 3-5 years' experience within procurement, purchasing, category management, supply chain, or a similar commercial role. Strong commercial awareness and business acumen. Demonstrated experience in supplier negotiations and cost management. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and market trends. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Experience working with ERP systems and procurement platforms. Desirable Experience Experience within wholesale, distribution, manufacturing, construction products, industrial supplies, hardware, or related sectors. Exposure to category management and product portfolio management. Experience supporting strategic sourcing initiatives. Professional procurement qualifications (CIPS or equivalent). Experience managing supplier performance and service improvement programmes.
