Create impact. Help clients navigate career transitions and organisational change. Right Management Ireland, part of ManpowerGroup, is a global leader in talent development, career transition, leadership development, executive coaching, and workforce transformation solutions. We partner with some of Ireland's largest employers, multinational organisations, and public sector bodies to help individuals and organisations thrive through change. Due to our ambitious growth plans, we are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Business Development Manager to join our Ireland team and drive new business growth across the Irish market. The Opportunity This is a strategic sales role focused on winning and developing new business opportunities with medium to large enterprise organisations across Ireland. This is a new role expanding on the existing client base currently managed by the Account Management team. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing opportunities in career transition (outplacement), executive and leadership coaching, career mobility, talent development, and change management solutions. The role will involve developing relationships with senior HR, Talent, Transformation, and Executive leaders while leveraging Right Management's global capabilities and extensive client base. Key Responsibilities New Business Development Identify, target, and win new enterprise clients across the Irish market. Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve annual revenue targets. Build relationships with CHROs, HR Directors, Talent Leaders, Transformation Directors, and senior business executives. Create a strong pipeline of opportunities through networking, referrals, industry engagement, and proactive prospecting. Work to targets and be independently driven to succeed in the marketplace. Strategic Account Growth Monetise existing global and multinational client relationships within Ireland. Partner with international colleagues to maximise opportunities arising from global contracts and frameworks. Identify cross-sell opportunities across Right Management's service portfolio. Partner with our sister ManpowerGroup Ireland sales team to develop local opportunities and the European Right Management sales team for cross border expansion. Career Transition & Workforce Change Solutions Position Right Management as the partner of choice for organisations undergoing restructuring, workforce transformation, mergers, acquisitions, and organisational change. Proactively identify opportunities arising from large-scale workforce restructuring programmes across Ireland. Engage with legal, HR, and executive stakeholders involved in workforce transition planning. Public & Private Sector Tenders Lead and support responses to RFPs, tenders, and procurement opportunities. Collaborate with internal subject matter experts to develop compelling, client-focused proposals. Manage tender opportunities across both public and private sectors. Market Leadership Act as a market ambassador for Right Management Ireland. Represent the business at industry events, conferences, and networking forums. Develop market intelligence and identify emerging client needs and trends. Key Business Development Focus Winning new business and clients in the Ireland outplacement market Monetising Globally signed outplacement and coaching contracts to grow revenues Locally. Winning new business in the public and private sector market via RFP's and RFI's Developing new business of contracts of €10k or more. The inside sales team explore opportunities in the smaller client and existing business focus area. About You You are a commercially driven business development professional with a strong track record of winning new enterprise business within professional services, consulting, talent, HR solutions, coaching, learning, or related sectors. Comfortable working independently as well as part of a small team. Essential Experience Minimum 5 years' successful business development experience. Strong track record of winning and growing enterprise accounts. Experience selling professional services or consultative solutions. Proven success engaging senior executive and HR stakeholders. Strong commercial, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Experience managing complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders. Desirable Experience Knowledge of career transition/outplacement services a distinct advantage. Familiarity with executive coaching, leadership development, career mobility, talent management, or change management solutions. Experience working within a consultancy, HR services business, coaching organisation, leadership development firm, or broader professional services environment. Exposure to public sector procurement and tender processes. Experience working with multinational organisations and global stakeholder groups. Increase revenue generated from global account opportunities. Establish Right Management as a leading provider for workforce restructuring and career transition solutions. Contribute significantly to the growth of the Ireland business. Why Join Right Management? Work with a recognised global leader in talent and career solutions. Access a world-class portfolio of coaching, leadership, career mobility, and workforce transformation offerings. Partner with leading organisations across Ireland and globally. Join a collaborative and highly regarded team. Ireland is an integral part of the wider European Right Management Business. Global focus, Local delivery. The role will be supported by the Market Leader, Account Managers, Inside Sales, Marketing and a Finance team. Part of the wider MPG Global business with a strong people first culture. Make a meaningful difference to organisations and individuals navigating change. Opportunity to make this new role your own and shape to your personal career development. Location: Dublin office based 3 days per week with flexibility for remote working on two days. Salary Range: €60k-€70k base. 20% OTE. Uncapped commissions To apply: Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your business development achievements and interest in joining Right Management Ireland. queue.title: Data Analyst
queue.description: We are currently recruiting for an experienced Data Analyst to join an established organisation within the financial services sector on an initial 4–6 week contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong Data Analyst with expertise in SAP, Power BI and commercial finance reporting to support a focused reporting and data improvement project. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing accurate financial reports and interactive dashboards, improving reporting processes and automating existing workflows to provide greater visibility into business performance. You will work closely with finance and business stakeholders to deliver reliable reporting solutions, improve data accuracy and ensure a smooth handover to internal teams. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyse reporting requirements from finance and commercial stakeholders to identify key business metrics and reporting priorities. Extract, validate and reconcile financial data from SAP and other relevant data sources. Design, develop and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and financial reports. Produce detailed reporting on revenue, costs, margins and profitability across different business areas. Develop reports comparing actual performance against budgets, forecasts and historical financial data. Identify financial trends, variances and key performance drivers to support commercial decision-making. Improve existing reporting processes through automation, data integration and enhanced data quality controls. Support monthly financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and ad hoc analysis. Troubleshoot reporting issues relating to data accuracy, refresh schedules and dashboard performance. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure reporting solutions meet business requirements. Document reporting processes, data models and technical workflows. Provide knowledge transfer and training to internal finance teams to support ongoing reporting activities. Essential Skills & Experience Proven experience working as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or Finance Data Analyst, ideally within a commercial finance environment. Strong hands-on experience with SAP financial data, including general ledger, cost centre and profit centre reporting. Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development, data modelling, DAX, Power Query and report publishing. Solid understanding of financial reporting concepts, including profit and loss, revenue, costs, margins, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with experience analysing and reconciling large datasets. Experience integrating and validating data from multiple sources to ensure reporting accuracy. Demonstrated ability to automate manual reporting processes and improve operational efficiency. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver results within tight deadlines. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into effective reporting solutions. Desirable Experience Experience working with SAP finance modules or SAP Report Painter. Knowledge of SQL, relational databases or automated data integration processes. Previous experience within financial services, insurance or another regulated industry. Experience producing commercial profitability, revenue or commission reporting. Relevant qualifications in Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Information Technology or a related discipline. Microsoft Power BI certification or equivalent professional training. How to Apply If you are an experienced Data Analyst with strong SAP and Power BI expertise and are interested in a short-term contract opportunity, please apply with your updated CV.
